prompts.node: Use case: identity-preserve. Project asset: production sprite atlas for the Bitcode Sat named Node. The attached PNG is the exact character identity and material reference. Create ONE transparent sprite atlas, landscape 3072 x 2048, an exact 3-column by 2-row regular grid of six full-body views of this same blue plush mini bot. NO text, NO grid lines, NO props, NO backgrounds, no ground shadow. Each cell has a generous transparent margin, centered identical body scale and feet baseline; keep antenna and feet fully inside its cell. Preserve the blue short soft flock texture, broad glossy black visor, cream feet, three cream horizontal stitched belly bars and small orange lightning antenna, same gentle studio lighting and same camera. Change only eye expression, subtle head tilt and arm gesture. EXACT ORDER left to right: top row 1 IDLE relaxed friendly cream pill eyes, arms resting; 2 FOCUS attentive slightly narrowed pill eyes, head tilted 2 degrees, one hand near cheek; 3 WORKING determined attentive eyes, both little arms reaching forward as if carefully working without an object. Bottom row 4 ASK questioning wide asymmetric eyes, one hand raised politely; 5 HAPPY two upward smiling arc eyes, both arms raised, no mouth; 6 CONCERNED gently worried slanted cream eyes, slight head tilt and arms close to body, no tears. All six must look like the supplied character, never a redesigned robot or symbol. The source has a slightly tilted head; preserve its charm. Real transparent alpha throughout empty space.
